pairs.old:
Get current timestamp with optional microsecond precision.
        
        Requires:
            - None
            
        Ensures:
            - Returns formatted datetime string
            - Default format: "YYYY-MM-DD @ HH:MM:SS TZ" 
            - Microsecond format: "YYYY-MM-DD @ HH:MM:SS.ffffff TZ"
            
        Args:
            microseconds: If True, include microseconds for unique IDs (default: False)
            
        Raises:
            - None
pairs.new:
Return the current timestamp as a formatted string.

        Requires:
            - None

        Ensures:
            - Returns a formatted datetime string.
            - The default format is "YYYY-MM-DD @ HH:MM:SS TZ".
            - With microseconds, the format is "YYYY-MM-DD @ HH:MM:SS.ffffff TZ".

        Args:
            microseconds: If True, include microseconds so the result works as a unique ID. Defaults to False.

        Raises:
            - None

pairs.old:
Literals the rewrite ALTERED. Absence is legal; mutation is not.

    Requires:
        - original and rewrite are strings

    Ensures:
        - returns a list of ( literal, sent_count, got_count ) for literals that
          appear MORE often than sent, and ( literal, 0, n ) for ones never sent
        - a literal appearing FEWER times is not a violation — dropping a
          sentence takes its literals with it, and that is the design
        - a mutation still registers, because the changed value is a literal
          that was never sent

    Raises:
        - nothing
pairs.new:
Return the literals that the rewrite changed or added.

    Requires:
        - original and rewrite are strings

    Ensures:
        - Returns a list of ( literal, sent_count, got_count ) for literals that appear more often than sent.
        - Returns ( literal, 0, n ) for literals that were never sent.
        - A literal that appears fewer times is not a violation, because dropping a sentence drops its literals.
        - A changed value still registers, because it is a literal that was never sent.

    Raises:
        - Nothing

pairs.old:
Update ~/.lora_env with the latest quantized model path for this model.

        Requires:
            - self.model_name is set
            - self.quantized_model_dirs is populated with {bits: path}
            - model_name exists in LORA_ENV_VAR_MAP

        Ensures:
            - ~/.lora_env is updated with new path for this model
            - Other model entries are preserved
            - Header comments and timestamp are updated
            - Prefers 8-bit path if available, falls back to 4-bit

        Raises:
            - IOError if file cannot be written
pairs.new:
Write the latest quantized model path for this model into ~/.lora_env.

        Requires:
            - self.model_name is set
            - self.quantized_model_dirs is populated with {bits: path}
            - model_name exists in LORA_ENV_VAR_MAP

        Ensures:
            - ~/.lora_env holds the new path for this model.
            - Entries for other models are preserved.
            - The header comments and timestamp are updated.
            - The 8-bit path is used when available, otherwise the 4-bit path.

        Raises:
            - IOError if the file cannot be written

pairs.old:
Create or refresh the scratch pub project that holds the extractor script.

    Requires:
        - dart is the path of a dart executable
        - data_root is the repo's own data directory, never the tree being indexed

    Ensures:
        - returns the scratch directory, under data_root, with pubspec.yaml, bin/dart_extract.dart
          and resolved packages
        - `pub get` runs offline first and online only when the offline run fails
        - an unchanged project with resolved packages skips `pub get`

    Raises:
        - DependencyMissing when the analyzer package cannot be resolved
        - OSError when the project files cannot be written
pairs.new:
Create or refresh the scratch pub project that holds the extractor script.

    Requires:
        - dart is the path of a dart executable
        - data_root is the repo's own data directory, and is never the tree being indexed

    Ensures:
        - Returns the scratch directory under data_root.
        - The directory holds pubspec.yaml, bin/dart_extract.dart and resolved packages.
        - `pub get` runs offline first, and online only when the offline run fails.
        - An unchanged project with resolved packages skips `pub get`.

    Raises:
        - DependencyMissing when the analyzer package cannot be resolved
        - OSError when the project files cannot be written

pairs.old:
Send ping messages to all connections and remove dead ones.
        
        This method is called periodically by the heartbeat background task
        to proactively detect and clean up dead WebSocket connections.
        
        Requires:
            - Method is called from async context
            - Configuration may disable heartbeat checking
            
        Ensures:
            - Sends sys_ping message to all active connections
            - Identifies and removes connections that fail to receive ping
            - Prints summary of removed connections
            - Returns early if heartbeat disabled in configuration
            
        Raises:
            - None (WebSocket failures handled gracefully)
pairs.new:
Ping every connection and remove the ones that fail to respond.

        The heartbeat background task calls this periodically to find and clean up dead WebSocket connections.

        Requires:
            - The method is called from an async context.
            - Configuration may disable heartbeat checking.

        Ensures:
            - Returns early if heartbeat is disabled in configuration.
            - Sends a sys_ping message to all active connections.
            - Removes connections that fail to receive the ping.
            - Prints a summary of the removed connections.

        Raises:
            - None. WebSocket failures are handled internally.

pairs.new:
Check whether a transcription matches any known command.

        Requires:

        Ensures:
